asked.item: Is content.text the wrong field / what to do instead

verdict.reason: The Instagram Story limitation sentences explain that caption text does not appear on Stories and say to add the text to the image or video instead.

steps.text: Instagram Stories do not support captions through Meta's publishing API, so text in an API, MCP, n8n, or Make.com caption field does not appear on the published Story.
For REST API requests, set the required content.text field to "".
To show text, add it to the image or video before publishing, then publish the finished media as a Story.
